laws.rule: Kyoto City accommodation tax from 1 March 2026, per person per night by room rate: under JPY 6,000 pays JPY 200; JPY 6,000 to 19,999 pays JPY 400; JPY 20,000 to 49,999 pays JPY 1,000; JPY 50,000 to 99,999 pays JPY 4,000; JPY 100,000 or more pays JPY 10,000.
laws.heading: Kyoto City accommodation tax (revised March 2026)

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: In Southern Gion (Gion-machi Minamigawa), the lanes off Hanamikoji are private roads: do not enter them or take photos there,. Signs posted by the local district say unauthorised photography or entry can incur a JPY 10,000 charge.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Hanamikoji Street itself stays open to the public.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Gion-machi Minamigawa district council; City of Kyoto
culture-and-protocol.note: The JPY 10,000 figure is the district's own notice, not a city fine.
